nodes.label: Karvey 3.11.1 Expert Panel Decision Report
nodes.rationale: Consolidates three independent judges plus owner proposal JU-01 into 35 verified findings, 30 recommendations and a 3-wave plan.

nodes.label: Agent-execution judge (AG)
Development-methods judge (DM)
Project-management judge (PM)
Owner Mauricio (proposal JU-01)
H-01: Phase values written by skills do not match orchestrator table
H-02: karvey-impl never writes phase
H-03: Dead end for changes without UI (mockup->architecture)
H-04: Hotfix lane collides with phase preconditions
H-05: design-graphic self-approves
H-06: -y auto-approves without by/role/ref
H-07: 'deployed' set while prod PR still open; archive accepts it
H-08: Session hook treats archive/ as the active change
H-09: Session hook injects both compact and full manifest
H-10: plan-gate false positive on 2> and destructive commands pass
H-11: plan-gate marker never expires, is global and agent-created
H-12: git-flow-guard evasions and false positive
H-13: enforcement.md promises integration-push block that is not implemented
H-14: Described hooks do not exist (clickup-sync-guard, standards-guard)
H-15: No hook guards the merge to prod
H-16: time_estimate overwritten with actual time
H-17: Double versioning: bump in impl and again in deploy
H-18: approvals.prod committed on dev
H-19: Archive commits without a branch, on dev after deploy
H-20: 6-step 'before push' checklist appears after the push
H-21: dev->master PR drags unapproved changes
H-22: Method repo skips its own gates (dogfooding)
H-23: 12 skills without description in the session listing
H-24: proposal.md is a phantom artifact
H-25: spec-delta.md has two paths
H-26: 9 duplicated rule copies
H-27: Plugin has no CI of its own
H-28: QA commits fixes although it 'only observes'
H-29: REVISION_PR_* at repo root read with ls -t
H-30: karvey-context shows no backlog, findings or incidents
H-31: Graphify runs every phase and every mockup iteration
H-32: Inconsistent rotation threshold (24h vs 8h)
H-33: Minor consistency issues (decision log path, E{1..99}, allowed-tools)
H-34: Instruction cost per cycle ~92k tokens
H-35: BUG-NN/D-NN/E{n} ID collision across parallel sessions
R-01: Single state machine with schema and script (karvey-state.py)
nodes.rationale: Foundation for everything else: lanes, judges, metrics and dashboard read phase and approvals.

nodes.label: R-02: Hooks that do what they say, a prod-gate and table tests
nodes.rationale: A skill guarantees nothing; an agent-created marker controls nothing; a gate blocking 2>/dev/null gets disabled.

nodes.label: R-03: Move deploy/archive commits off dev and reorder checklist
nodes.rationale: Contradicting instructions force rule violation or unplanned questions.

nodes.label: R-04: Single versioning moment
nodes.rationale: Semver versions releases, not commits.

nodes.label: R-05: Do not overwrite the estimate; keep estimate and actual
nodes.rationale: Minute-estimation hypothesis is valuable but code erases the evidence to validate it.

nodes.label: R-06: Session hook: archive/, bounded injection, state.json by script
nodes.rationale: Removes false restores after archive and makes drift machine-measured.

nodes.label: R-07: Plugin as code: no copies, resolvable paths, CI linter
nodes.rationale: Doc drift is caught before release.

nodes.label: R-08: Release per change with release manifest and trunk mode
nodes.rationale: Approved unit is the change, released unit is the branch: a governance gap, worse in multi-tenant.

nodes.label: R-09: Lanes by change size
nodes.rationale: Without a cheap legitimate path the team takes an illegitimate one.

nodes.label: R-10: Fewer, heavier human gates without auto-approval
nodes.rationale: A gate that rarely rejects becomes a rubber stamp; fuse to 3 only together with judges (R-11).

nodes.label: R-11: Expert judge panels at early gates (JU-01, karvey-judges)
nodes.rationale: Independent clean-context review at the cheapest point of the cycle; four-eyes moved earlier.

nodes.label: R-12: Test-first and REQ->task->commit->test traceability matrix
nodes.rationale: A requirement without a test becomes visible before merge.

nodes.label: R-13: Security gate with deterministic tools
nodes.rationale: Reproducible security verdict.

nodes.label: R-14: Flow and DORA metrics from artifacts, with phase_history
nodes.rationale: Condition for evaluating Wave 2 with data.

nodes.label: R-15: Per-phase context budget and progressive loading
nodes.rationale: Reorganizes all skills; do it once content is stable after Wave 2.

nodes.label: R-16: Graphify and tracker ritual off the hot path
nodes.rationale: Mid-phase nobody consumes the graph; next phase reads artifacts directly.

nodes.label: R-17: Living specs: merge spec-delta in the code PR
nodes.rationale: spec == prod; DM's timing with AG's script.

nodes.label: R-18: Complete dashboard: open work, aging and WIP
nodes.rationale: One place to see what is blocked and who it waits on.

nodes.label: R-19: Stakeholder visibility and 'your turn' events
nodes.rationale: Less approval waiting.

nodes.label: R-20: Scripts for release-gate, IDs, health score and evidence
nodes.rationale: Reproducible gates and zero duplicate IDs.

nodes.label: R-21: QA observes without fixing; artifacts inside the change; stack rules to standards
nodes.rationale: Reviewer independence and correct per-change revision.

nodes.label: R-22: Short frontmatter descriptions without generic triggers
nodes.rationale: All 32 skills visible and ~2.3k tokens less per session.

nodes.label: R-23: Canary becomes post-deploy verification with thresholds
nodes.rationale: Measurable CFR and MTTR.

nodes.label: R-24: Pending decisions (Q-NN) and risks with owner and date
nodes.rationale: Open questions need an owner who answers in time.

nodes.label: R-25: Cost per change also with a single agent
nodes.rationale: Per-client margin visibility; judge cost tracked separately.

nodes.label: R-26: Project-level design system; design-graphic as delta
nodes.rationale: Avoid redefining palette/typography every change; UX judge scores.

nodes.label: R-27: Unambiguous WBS for what a Feature is
nodes.rationale: Single scope decomposition.

nodes.label: R-28: Multi-client portfolio view
nodes.rationale: Answer 'how are we doing with client X' in one command.

nodes.label: R-29: Backlog with WSJF prioritization and done-direct state
nodes.rationale: Explicit criteria for what comes next.

nodes.label: R-30: Portability to other runtimes and teams
nodes.rationale: Adoption outside HainTech and Claude Code.

nodes.label: karvey-state.py (proposed state-machine script)
prod-gate.sh (proposed prod-merge hook)
